title: Can't export to Android on 4.5
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1: android export works just fine

4.5: android export gives error

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable (876b29033) - Freedesktop SDK 25.08 (Flatpak runtime) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT (RADV NAVI32) - AMD Ryzen 5 7600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 30.49 GiB memory

### Issue description

Last version 4.4.1, I was able to export to Android just fine. Now, in the latest 4.5 update, I get this:

<details>

(Output from Remote Deploy. The same thing happens when I try to export it to an .apk file normally, but for some reason I can't copy the error text there)
